```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
ntse_tbl = readr::read_csv("data/ntse_endowment_us_and_canada_2020.csv")

ntse_tbl = ntse_tbl |>
  dplyr::rename_with(trimws) |>                         # " endowment_fy_20 " -> "endowment_fy_20"
  dplyr::mutate(
    id                = as.character(id),
    hbcu_indicator    = hbcu_indicator == 1,
    carnegie_category = as.character(carnegie_category),
    enrollment = as.integer(enrollment)
  )

dplyr::glimpse(ntse_tbl)
```



```{r}
ntse_tbl = ntse_tbl |>
  dplyr::rename_with(stringr::str_trim) |>          # header is " endowment_fy_20 " in the raw file
  dplyr::mutate(
    id                = as.character(id),           # an ID is a label, not a number to do math on
    hbcu_indicator    = hbcu_indicator == 1,        # 1 = HBCU, 2 = not; becomes TRUE/FALSE (blanks stay NA)
    carnegie_category = as.character(carnegie_category)  # category codes 0-5, not quantities
  )

dplyr::glimpse(ntse_tbl)
```

```{r}
ntse_tbl_clean <- ntse_tbl |>
  dplyr::rename(endowment_fy_20 = ` endowment_fy_20 `) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    hbcu_indicator    = factor(hbcu_indicator),
    carnegie_category = factor(carnegie_category)
  )

```
